lastRequest: Build a simple fullstack Todo app with Express REST API, Prisma SQLite database, and a React frontend with dark mode, task creation, completion toggle, and delete.

tasks.title: Database Schema and Prisma Setup
tasks.description: Configure SQLite database, define Todo schema in Prisma, and generate client libraries.

tasks.title: Express API Implementation and Validation
tasks.description: Develop Express REST routes for full Todo CRUD, utilizing Zod schema parsing and error handling.

tasks.title: Frontend Scaffold and Theme Context
tasks.description: Set up Vite, Tailwind, Lucide Icons, and implement local storage-backed dark/light mode toggle.

tasks.title: TanStack Query and Optimistic Todo UI
tasks.description: Implement Todo list view, creation form, search filters, and handle CRUD using optimistic UI updates.

tasks.title: Docker Setup and Integration Verification
tasks.description: Create production-ready multi-stage Dockerfile for orchestration, verifying data persistence.
